# cmake — sourced from FetchContent declares in CMakeLists.txt (a git tag pin
# and a tarball URL whose version is read from the filename; its SHA-256
# URL_HASH rides the hashes.Map path, asserted by the ecosystem parser tests)
# plus a CPM shorthand in cmake/deps.cmake.

purl pkg:github/nlohmann/json@3.11.3
